Brand Recommendation.Background: Project Rp was initiated in 1985 as a New Brands project which combined R&D's technologies into a product offering smokers a personal as well as a social acceptability benefit. The RP technology combines a patented, magnesium hydroxide cigarette puffed flued cured tobacco, 176 Turkish tobacco) to produce the following benefits: Less sidestream smoke, Low gas phase elements in mainstream smoke, Low biological activity as-defined by the Ames test, Reduction in the amount of total smoke.

Potential Advertising Claims: Reduced gas phase levels in mainstream and sidestream smoke
Benefits: Low gas phase elements in mainstream smoke
Reduction in the amount of total smoke
